company.name: NavierAI
company.shortDescription: NavierAI develops artificial intelligence software that accelerates engineering simulations and design workflows.
company.description: NavierAI develops artificial intelligence software that accelerates engineering simulations and design workflows using physics-based machine learning models. The company offers platforms and autonomous engineering agent tools that automate setup, execution, and analysis of complex simulations such as computational fluid dynamics, enabling engineers to iterate on designs with faster feedback. Its technology integrates with existing design and simulation systems to streamline routine engineering tasks and support exploration of design spaces. NavierAI’s solutions target aerospace, mechanical engineering, and other technical teams looking to reduce manual modeling effort and speed decision cycles.
